headline.en: UNI still net inflationary at $4.08 with volume collapsed to 0.16% turnover; only v4 fee activation breaks the pattern.
headline.zh: UNI 在 $4.08 仍处净通胀, 24h 换手率仅 0.16%, 唯有 v4 fee 激活能扭转格局。

keyChanges.en: Net emission still +1.79%/yr — buyback of 4.0M UNI covers only 20% of the 20M fixed annual issuance; burn narrative is math-broken at this price/revenue mix.
keyChanges.zh: 净通胀仍为 +1.79%/年 — 回购 4.0M UNI 仅覆盖 20M 固定年增发的 20%, 当前价格/收入组合下销毁叙事在数学上站不住。

keyChanges.en: 24h volume $4.01M on $2.55B market cap = 0.16% turnover — effectively no participation; thin tape means any real seller moves price disproportionately.
keyChanges.zh: 24h 成交量 $4.01M 对应 $2.55B 市值, 换手率仅 0.16% — 参与度接近归零, 薄成交下任何真实卖压都会造成不成比例的下跌。

keyChanges.en: Two revenue-expansion temp checks live simultaneously — v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — the first credible upside catalysts since UNIfication.
keyChanges.zh: 两项收入扩张提案同时进入 temp check — v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张 — 是 UNIfication 以来首批有分量的多头催化剂。

contrarianObservation.en: If BOTH v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion pass, protocol revenue can realistically 2-3x toward $200M+ ARR by Q4. At that level, 17% buyback flips net emission negative around current spot. A smart long isn't chasing price — they're front-running the arithmetic before governance prices it in.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若 v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张同时通过, Q4 协议收入有望 2-3 倍至 $200M+ ARR。届时 17% 回购可令净排放在当前价位附近转负。聪明的多头不是在追价, 而是在治理定价之前抢跑这道算术。

watchNext.en: v4 Protocol Fees temp check → snapshot vote progression; a passing snapshot is the single highest-signal event of the month.
watchNext.zh: v4 Protocol Fees temp check → snapshot 投票进展; 若通过, 是本月信号最强的单一事件。

watchNext.en: Any Fee Switch working group update on the real-yield RFC — silence here means the reflexive burn model persists and DCF re-rating is off the table.
watchNext.zh: Fee Switch 工作组关于 real-yield RFC 的任何更新 — 若继续沉默, 反身性销毁模型延续, DCF 重定价无从谈起。

watchNext.en: UNI/ETH ratio at 0.002211 — break above 0.0024 confirms alt rotation into UNI; break below 0.0020 confirms structural capitulation continues.
watchNext.zh: UNI/ETH 比率 0.002211 — 上破 0.0024 确认 alt 资金轮动至 UNI; 下破 0.0020 确认结构性投降延续。

fullReasoning.en: The setup is bearish but not urgently so. UNI sits at $4.0760, 32% below the DAO's own $5.96 treasury burn anchor and inside the retail capitulation zone. The core problem is unchanged: at $96M annualized protocol revenue, the 17% buyback consumes only ~4M UNI/yr against 20M UNI fixed emission — net +1.79% dilution. The burn story is math-broken at this price/revenue mix. What's more alarming today is $4.01M 24h volume on a $2.55B market cap — 0.16% turnover, effectively no participation. Thin tape means any real seller pushes price disproportionately. TVL is flat (+0.18% 7d) and Unichain at $27M remains a rounding error. The +6.56% 7d bounce looks like short-covering into neutral funding (+0.01%), not accumulation, and L/S ratio 1.76 shows retail already leaning long — historically caps such rallies. The v4 Protocol Fees temp check is the only clean bullish path: activation materially expands the revenue base and could flip net emission negative. Without it, and without the real-yield RFC advancing, UNI grinds toward the $3-3.5 support zone. Position defensively, keep dry powder for the temp check outcome, and do not chase this 7d strength on this volume profile.
fullReasoning.zh: 局势偏空但并非急迫下跌。UNI 现价 $4.0760, 较 DAO 自身设定的 $5.96 国库销毁锚定价低 32%, 处于散户投降区间。核心问题未变: 在年化协议收入 $96.04M 水平下, 17% 回购仅消耗约 4M UNI/年, 而固定年增发 20M UNI, 净通胀 +1.79% — 当前价格与收入组合下, 销毁叙事在数学上不成立。今日更值得警惕的是 24h 成交量仅 $4.01M, 而市值 $2.55B, 换手率 0.16%, 参与度接近归零。薄成交量意味着任何真实卖压都会造成不成比例的下跌。TVL 停滞 (+0.18% 7d), Unichain TVL 仅 $27M 可忽略。7d 涨幅 +6.56% 更像 funding 中性 (+0.01%) 下的空头回补而非资金介入; 多空比 1.76 显示散户已偏多, 历史上此类反弹上限受限。v4 Protocol Fees temp check 是唯一干净的多头路径 — 若激活, 收入基数显著扩张, 有望令净排放转负。若该提案受阻且 real-yield RFC 未推进, UNI 将向 $3-3.5 支撑区间阴跌。防守为主, 保留弹药等待 temp check 结果, 不要在这种成交结构下追 7d 反弹。
